# Xiaomi Market Bypass An LSPosed module that helps Xiaomi Market run correctly on AOSP and crDroid ROMs. ## What it fixes - Missing MIUI framework classes and methods used by Xiaomi Market. - Xiaomi Market compatibility checks that can crash or block flows on AOSP. - Invalid Settings.Secure writes from a normal third-party app. - PackageInstaller confirmation started while Xiaomi Market is in the background. - Installs that remain stuck after a committed install session. ## Requirements - Android with LSPosed installed. - Xiaomi Market installed as `com.xiaomi.market`. - Enable this module for `com.xiaomi.market` and `com.android.providers.downloads` in LSPosed. ## Usage 1. Install the module APK. 2. Enable the module in LSPosed. 3. Select `com.xiaomi.market` and `com.android.providers.downloads` as the module scope. 4. Force stop Xiaomi Market and the DownloadProvider, or reboot the device. The DownloadProvider scope is required for pause and resume on AOSP/crDroid ROMs whose provider does not reschedule a paused download when the Market resumes it. ## Tested Validated with Xiaomi Market v4.111.0 on a Xiaomi Redmi Note 13 4G (`sapphire`) running crDroid Android 16. For source updates, issue reports, and the latest documentation, visit the [source repository](https://github.com/pbzin/XiaomiMarketBypass).
